description: Deadlines of the stm32n6-demo's threads for zprof's schedulability analysis (serve --deadlines). Only these make the verdict; a periodic thread not listed is analysed against its period for information. release: the object a job starts from (its symbol, or "sleep"), when the thread waits longest on something else. period_us: a loop without one release object; a job is one period of its work.

main.why: One panel refresh at 60 Hz: a frame handed over later is a dropped frame. Its loop sleeps one to three times a frame, so a job is one refresh period of its work

audio_tid.why: One 128-frame block at the DAC's 47.78 kHz: a refill later is an underrun

mic_tid.why: One 128-sample half of the microphone's DMA buffer at the same clock: later, the half is overwritten
